question: ap1
constraint: with only a single time point measured per sample
prompt:
Constraint: every one of your ideas must be carried out with only a single time point measured per sample. Within that constraint, make the ideas as informative as possible.

Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Single-cell multiome in previously stimulated vs naive cells
ideas.description: Do joint scRNA/scATAC-seq at one time point long after stimulus withdrawal on primed and naive populations. Test whether AP-1 (FOS/JUN) motif accessibility, footprints and target-gene expression stay elevated in primed cells, and whether the primed cells carry a distinct, stable AP-1-linked chromatin state.

ideas.title: AP-1 binding and chromatin state profiling (CUT&Tag/ChIP) at memory loci
ideas.description: At a single post-stimulus time point, profile JUN/FOS occupancy with H3K27ac, H3K4me1 and accessibility in primed vs naive cells. Test whether AP-1 stays bound at, or leaves behind, latent/primed enhancers, and whether the sites retained correlate with enhanced re-induction of nearby genes.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 degradation after priming, then readout
ideas.description: Prime cells, let the stimulus decay, then rapidly deplete AP-1 (dTAG/AID degron of JUN/FOS, or dominant-negative A-FOS) and measure chromatin accessibility and transcription at one later time point versus controls. If the primed state is lost, AP-1 is needed to maintain memory. If it persists, AP-1 only initiates it.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation response test with AP-1 perturbation (single endpoint)
ideas.description: Give primed and naive cells, with or without AP-1 perturbation during priming only, an identical second stimulus. Measure RNA-seq or a reporter at one fixed time point after it, and compare the magnitude and speed of the response. This separates AP-1's role in establishing memory from its role in executing the response.

ideas.title: Single-cell AP-1 protein level/state snapshot with lineage-tracked heritability
ideas.description: Use imaging or flow cytometry of endogenous tagged FOS/JUN with an AP-1 reporter in one fixed snapshot of a clonal population, such as sister cells or barcoded clones. Test whether the high and low AP-1 states are shared among related cells beyond chance, which indicates heritable memory. Correlate the states with the history of the stimulus (e.g. a prior pulse) and the downstream targets.
